gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-mongoli: Noto Sans Mongolian reads as a plain sans with terminals that flare outward, modern and quietly sure of itself. And Happy Monkey above it looks marker-drawn, bold and a bit goofy, so a long page of text feels loose instead of stiff.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Noto Sans New Tai Lue reads as a plain sans whose round letters look cupped rather than clenched, soft and modern. Happy Monkey's unvarying line makes the pairing instantly friendly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-nko: Happy Monkey draws every line at an unvarying thickness, with wide gaps in its e, which gives it a bold, distinctive look. Noto Sans NKo keeps things readable beneath it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-nko-unj: Happy Monkey has a ballpoint's pressure-free line, bold and distinctive without any fuss. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined follows as a sans with wide openings on its small letters, approachable and easy to settle into beside the heading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Wire-smooth and cheeky, Happy Monkey gives the heading a bold, distinctive line that glides under the eye. But Noto Sans Old South Arabian does the quieter job, with curved strokes that end before turning inward, approachable and clean.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Happy Monkey keeps its joints tidy where strokes meet, never thinning or bulging, so the heading stays bold and distinctive. Noto Sans Shavian is the plain sans with rope-loose curves for the text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ojuju: Ink that looks poured at one width gives Happy Monkey its bold, distinctive heading voice. Ojuju brings the tempered contrast of a lightly flexed spring wire, so give the body a modest size next to the loud heading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-overpass:
Overpass reads as a plain sans, modern and professional.

Its strokes never swing between bold-looking and light-looking, and Happy Monkey's wide-gapped e makes a bold, distinctive partner for that steadiness.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-palanquin: Bold and distinctive, Happy Monkey holds a constant stroke from top to baseline in the heading. Palanquin is the professional sans, with curved letters and wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-philosopher:
Philosopher is a clean, professional sans with plenty of daylight inside its curves.

Happy Monkey cuts every line at a single depth, and that bold, distinctive heading against soft, gentle shifts in thickness is the pair's strongest quality.
